measurement_correction: The prior admin_affordability_ratio compares capital against a maximum-unconstrained full-gap interval increment. It is a conservative ceiling test, not the exact condition affordable_gain < desired_gain used by the production transition. Do not report its shortfall frequency as an exact finance-binding frequency.
interpretation: A sharp marginal-capital plateau is observed, but the strict preregistered two-regime architecture is not confirmed because removing low-capital scarcity changes 180-day administrative gap closure by only ~0.65 percentage points. Nonfinancial throughput/institutional dynamics dominate on this support.
next_test: Instrument production desired_gain and affordable_gain immediately before each state-regeneration event on already-observed support or a separately preregistered fresh block before quantifying exact fiscal-binding frequency.
guard: Do not use Afghanistan as empirical validation of the model. It is a conceptual comparator for multidimensional absorptive capacity.
